name: Amapiano Skip Shuffle
desc: FUSES amapiano's spacious sparse-four kit (drums.amapiano.sparse_four) with UK garage's skippy swung shuffle (drums.ukg.two_step): four-ish kicks with air between them, but the hats and rims skip in late-shifted 2-step pairs.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").late("[0 ${skip}]*4").gain(saw.range(${airy}*.5,${airy}).fast(4)), s("~ rim ~ [~ rim] ~ rim ~ ~").late(${skip}).gain(${airy}*.9).shape(.3)).lpf(9000).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.45).gain(${gain}), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").late("[0 ${skip}]*4").ply("<1 1 2 1>").gain(saw.range(${airy}*.55,${airy}).fast(4)), s("~ rim [~ rim] [~ rim] ~ rim ~ [rim ~]").late(${skip}).gain(${airy}).shape(.35), s("~ ~ ~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${airy}*.8)).lpf(10000).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
